title: Echo of the Last Minute
subtitle: Power · Original supernatural power proposal · Fate Core extra

fields.label: Permission / cost
fields.value: Requires a chronomancy-related aspect and an attuned hourglass. Costs one stunt slot; an additional paid stunt reduces refresh by 1 if the character has used their free allocation. Not included in Ira's starting sheet.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Once per scene, spend a fate point while touching a fixed surface to observe its last minute as a faint sensory echo from that location. This grants access to the recorded event, not an automatic advantage or a guaranteed answer.

fields.label: Limits
fields.value: One vantage, no thoughts, no future events and no events beyond the last minute. Walls still block sight. Illusions in the original event remain illusions.

fields.label: Opposition / follow-up
fields.value: An active temporal ward can oppose access with Lore; use overcome only when that opposition matters. Investigating an unclear echo is a separate relevant action.

fields.label: Counterplay / cost in fiction
fields.value: Move the evidence out of range, obscure the scene or let the minute pass. The hourglass glows while used, so observers can recognize the attempt. Table approval required.
